summary: SOLD BY MODERN METHOD OF AUCTION Situated at the head of a pleasant cul-de-sac within a well-established residential area, this spacious four-bedroom terraced family home is surrounded by similar properties and located within the popular Northumberland town of Ashington
description:
This property is for sale by the Modern Method of Auction, meaning the buyer and seller are to Complete within 56 days (the "Reservation Period"). Interested parties personal data will be shared with the Auctioneer (iamsold). If considering buying with a mortgage, inspect and consider the property carefully with your lender before bidding. A Buyer Information Pack is provided. The winning bidder will pay £349.00 including VAT for this pack which you must view before bidding. The buyer signs a Reservation Agreement and makes payment of a non-refundable Reservation Fee of 4.5% of the purchase price including VAT, subject to a minimum of £6,600.00 including VAT. This is paid to reserve the property to the buyer during the Reservation Period and is paid in addition to the purchase price. This is considered within calculations for Stamp Duty Land Tax. Services may be recommended by the Agent or Auctioneer in which they will receive payment from the service provider if the service is taken. Payment varies but will be no more than £450.00. These services are optional.

Known for its strong community atmosphere, excellent local amenities and abundance of nearby green spaces, the area also benefits from close proximity to the stunning Northumberland coastline, offering residents the perfect balance between town living and coastal lifestyle. Ashington continues to grow in popularity thanks to its excellent transport links and accessibility to surrounding areas. The south of the town is bordered by the picturesque River Wansbeck, whilst the beautiful North Sea coastline at Newbiggin-by-the-Sea is approximately 5 km (3 miles) away, providing scenic beaches, coastal walks and leisure facilities. The city of Newcastle upon Tyne lies approximately 15 miles away and can be easily accessed via the A189 Spine Road, making the property ideal for commuters. This property represents an excellent investment opportunity, offering scope for light refurbishment and modernisation, allowing prospective purchasers to add their own style and potentially increase value. Equally, the generous internal layout and substantial plot mean the property would suit a wide range of buyers including families, first-time purchasers or investors looking for a well-located home with strong rental potential. Occupying a generous plot, the property benefits from an enclosed frontage with double gated access leading to a gravelled driveway providing off-street parking. To the rear there is a particularly spacious, larger-than-average garden offering excellent outdoor space with plenty of potential for landscaping, family use or further development subject to the necessary permissions. Internally, the accommodation is well proportioned and briefly comprises: entrance hallway providing access to the principal ground floor rooms, a bright and comfortable lounge ideal for relaxing, a separate dining room perfect for family meals or entertaining guests, and a kitchen offering ample space for modernisation. To the first floor there are four well-sized bedrooms, providing flexible accommodation for family living, guest rooms or home working space, together with a family bathroom. The property is offered for sale with the added benefit of no onward chain, ensuring a smoother purchase process. Early viewings are highly recommended to fully appreciate the space, location and potential this home has to offer.

ENTRANCE Accessed via a UPVC framed double glazed aluminium entrance door, with a UPVC double glazed window allowing for natural light. The hallway benefits from a radiator and provides staircase access to the first floor accommodation, along with access to the ground floor living areas.

LOUNGE A bright and spacious lounge featuring a UPVC framed double glazed window that fills the room with natural light. The space is finished with laminate flooring and a radiator, and offers direct access to the dining room, creating a versatile layout ideal for both relaxing and entertaining.

DINING ROOM A well-proportioned dining room with a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing plenty of natural light. The room features laminate flooring and a radiator, with a door providing convenient access into the kitchen, making it ideal for family meals or entertaining guests.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a range of base and wall units complemented by laminate work surfaces and an inset sink with drainer. It includes an integrated oven and hob, along with plumbing for an automatic washing machine. A UPVC framed double glazed door and window provide natural light and access to the rear garden. Additional features include a recess with a shelved storage cupboard and a tiled floor, combining practicality with a bright, functional layout.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The landing provides access to all first-floor accommodation and features a built-in storage cupboard housing the combination gas central heating boiler, offering practical storage and easy access for maintenance.

BEDROOM ONE A generously sized bedroom featuring a UPVC framed double glazed window that fills the room with natural light. The room benefits from a radiator and a built-in storage cupboard, providing both comfort and practical storage space.

BEDROOM TWO A spacious bedroom with a UPVC framed double glazed window, allowing plenty of natural light to fill the room. It features a radiator and a built-in storage cupboard, offering both practicality and a comfortable living space.

BEDROOM THREE A well-proportioned bedroom featuring a UPVC framed double glazed window that provides natural light. The room includes a radiator and a built-in storage cupboard, combining practicality with a comfortable living space.

BEDROOM FOUR A bright and versatile bedroom with a UPVC framed double glazed window, allowing natural light to fill the space. The room is fitted with a radiator and offers flexibility for use as a bedroom, home office, or guest room.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a white suite comprising a panelled bath with an electric shower over, a wash hand basin, and a WC. The walls are partially tiled, and the room features a UPVC framed double glazed window and a radiator, creating a bright and functional space.

EXTERNALLY The property enjoys an attractive frontage with a gravelled garden area, providing ample off-road parking, accessed via charming wooden double gates and enclosed by mature hedging, offering both privacy and kerb appeal. Gated access to the rear opens onto a truly impressive garden that is larger than typically found for this style of home. The rear garden features a paved patio area, perfect for alfresco dining, social gatherings, or simply relaxing outdoors. Beyond this, a substantial L-shaped lawn stretches out, interspersed with a variety of mature trees and carefully maintained shrubs, creating a peaceful, private oasis. The garden offers both space and versatility, ideal for family play, gardening, or entertaining. Adding to its practicality, the garden also includes a double brick-built outbuilding, providing secure storage for tools, garden equipment, or outdoor furniture, while maintaining the aesthetic appeal of the space. Overall, the exterior of this property complements the generous interior, offering a blend of functionality, privacy, and enjoyment for its occupants.
